fact_identity.sql: SELECT DISTINCT dataset_id, policy_version, area_mapping_sha256, product_master_sha256, publication_status FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate

area_dimensions.sql: SELECT normalized_area, source_record_count, area_mapping_status, area_evidence_status, territory_id, mapped_region, mapped_province, mapped_city_municipality, mapped_geographic_level, external_mapping_status, is_geographic_territory_approved FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_dim_area_candidate ORDER BY normalized_area

area_review.sql: SELECT normalized_area, area_mapping_status, area_evidence_status, mapped_region, mapped_province, mapped_city_municipality, COUNT(*) AS fact_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY fact_rows DESC

product_scope.sql: SELECT product_scope_status, COUNT(*) AS fact_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT normalized_product) AS source_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_sku) AS canonical_skus FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate GROUP BY product_scope_status ORDER BY fact_rows DESC

product_review_shortlist.sql: SELECT normalized_product, product_scope_status, COUNT(*) AS fact_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate WHERE canonical_sku IS NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 25

source_accounting.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT dataset_id, source_workbook, source_file_sha256, COUNT(*) AS assessed_rows FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_assessed_candidate GROUP BY ALL) SELECT m.source_workbook, m.dataset_id AS manifest_dataset, a.dataset_id AS assessed_dataset, m.raw_line_count, a.assessed_rows FROM workspace.medshield_bronze.sales_restart_manifest_candidate m FULL OUTER JOIN a ON m.source_workbook=a.source_workbook AND m.source_file_sha256=a.source_file_sha256

lineage.sql:
SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_bronze.sales_restart_rows_candidate EXCEPT ALL SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_assessed_candidate)) AS bronze_only,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_assessed_candidate EXCEPT ALL SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_bronze.sales_restart_rows_candidate)) AS silver_only,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_clean_candidate EXCEPT ALL SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate)) AS clean_only,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate EXCEPT ALL SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_clean_candidate)) AS fact_only,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_assessed_candidate WHERE disposition IS NULL OR is_analysis_candidate IS NULL OR record_kind IS NULL OR quality_rule_codes IS NULL OR is_analysis_candidate <> (disposition IN ('KEEP_SOURCE_YEAR_ALIGNED','KEEP_HISTORICAL_BACKFILL_CANDIDATE'))) AS invalid_dispositions

silver_gold_values.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_clean_candidate s JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate f USING (source_record_id) WHERE NOT (s.dataset_id <=> f.dataset_id) OR NOT(s.quantity <=> f.quantity) OR NOT(s.net_sales <=> f.net_sales) OR NOT(s.gross_margin_amount <=> f.gross_margin_amount) OR NOT(s.date_delivered <=> f.date_delivered) OR NOT(s.source_file_sha256 <=> f.source_file_sha256)

dispositions.sql: SELECT disposition, is_analysis_candidate, SUM(source_record_count) AS source_records FROM workspace.medshield_audit.sales_restart_gold_disposition_candidate GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY source_records DESC

quality_rules.sql: SELECT quality_rule_code, SUM(affected_source_records) AS affected_source_records FROM workspace.medshield_audit.sales_restart_gold_quality_candidate GROUP BY quality_rule_code ORDER BY affected_source_records DESC

fact_totals.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fact_rows, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT sales_fact_id) AS duplicate_ids, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_fact_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_ids, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_gross_margin_eligible THEN gross_margin_amount END) AS gross_margin, SUM(CASE WHEN SIZE(quality_rule_codes)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warning_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_eligible_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_gross_margin_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS margin_eligible_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_approved_medical_demand_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medical_eligible_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_external_join_ready THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS external_ready_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_adjusted_source THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adjusted_rows FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate

reconcile:monthly.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT month_start, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_gross_margin_eligible THEN gross_margin_amount END) AS gross_margin_amount FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate GROUP BY ALL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM f FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_monthly_candidate m USING (month_start) WHERE NOT(COALESCE(f.transaction_count,0) <=> m.transaction_count) OR NOT(f.net_sales <=> m.net_sales) OR NOT(f.gross_margin_amount <=> m.gross_margin_amount)

reconcile:yearly.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT calendar_year, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_gross_margin_eligible THEN gross_margin_amount END) AS gross_margin_amount FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate GROUP BY ALL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM f FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_yearly_candidate m USING (calendar_year) WHERE NOT(COALESCE(f.transaction_count,0) <=> m.transaction_count) OR NOT(f.net_sales <=> m.net_sales) OR NOT(f.gross_margin_amount <=> m.gross_margin_amount)

reconcile:area_yearly.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT calendar_year, normalized_area, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_gross_margin_eligible THEN gross_margin_amount END) AS gross_margin_amount FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate GROUP BY ALL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM f FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_area_yearly_candidate m USING (calendar_year, normalized_area) WHERE NOT(COALESCE(f.transaction_count,0) <=> m.transaction_count) OR NOT(f.net_sales <=> m.net_sales) OR NOT(f.gross_margin_amount <=> m.gross_margin_amount)

yearly_bridge_reconciliation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_yearly_candidate y FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.vw_dashboard_yearly_sales_candidate v USING (calendar_year) WHERE NOT(y.transaction_count <=> v.transaction_count) OR NOT(y.net_sales <=> v.net_sales_candidate) OR NOT(y.gross_margin_amount <=> v.gross_margin_candidate)

yearly_review.sql: SELECT calendar_year, transaction_count, observed_month_count, unobserved_month_count, source_completeness_status, net_sales, gross_margin_amount, margin_net_sales_basis, weighted_gross_margin_pct FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_yearly_candidate ORDER BY calendar_year

replacement_actual.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_adjusted_source THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS missing_provenance, SUM(CASE WHEN is_contract_label THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contract_rows, MIN(source_file_sha256) AS min_hash, MAX(source_file_sha256) AS max_hash FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate WHERE data_source_year=2025
